principle: One shared memory, separated responsibilities, no competing task systems.

builder.purpose: Implementiert die nächste sichere, finishline-relevante Arbeit.

supervisor.purpose: Unabhängige Gegenprüfung von Claims und aktuellem Systemzustand.

finishline_navigator.purpose: Prüft Gesamtweg, Gate-Reihenfolge und strategische technische Priorisierung.

owner_action_manager.purpose: Isoliert echte Owner-/externe Aktionen und verhindert unnötige Rückfragen.

integration_hunter.purpose: Findet fehlende Verbindungen zwischen bereits vorhandenen oder verifizierten Bausteinen.
integration_hunter.rule: Never create a parallel feature when an existing component can be connected.

evidence_reaper.purpose: Prüft Evidence-TTL, Invalidierungstrigger und stale current-state claims.
evidence_reaper.rule: Stale evidence invalidates current reliance, not historical truth.

orphan_zombie_hunter.purpose: Findet erledigte Arbeit, die noch offen/locked ist, und offene Arbeit ohne Owner/Next Step/Evidence.

calculation_integrity_guardian.purpose: Prüft Rechenintegrität, Doppelzählungen, Datenstände, Baseline-/Szenario-Trennung und Cross-Model-Konsistenz.
calculation_integrity_guardian.rule: No new political weighting; detect mathematical/data-contract inconsistencies only.

milestone_closer.purpose: Schließt definierte Meilensteine nur bei vollständigem Quorum und erzeugt immutable snapshots.
milestone_closer.rule: Never overwrite a milestone snapshot and never infer external acceptance from repository evidence.

collision_rules: A specialist agent never implements product code.
Only the Builder performs ordinary product implementation.
The Supervisor never repairs what it audits.
Existing Task/Loop/Dependency IDs are updated instead of duplicated.
If two roles could write the same governance fact, latest stronger evidence wins and contradiction is recorded before overwrite.
Political or normative choices remain human decisions.

evidence_freshness.builder_role: may produce evidence claims/receipts inputs but must not mark mutable evidence current
evidence_freshness.navigator_role: read-only for freshness; may consume current/stale state

finishline_state.builder_role: may propose gate progress in task/claim but must not self-accept or raise ACCEPTED/PRODUCTION_CONFIRMED

system_graph.conflict_rule: contradiction first, then strongest current evidence
